summary: Describes OAuth 1.0, a method that lets a client access server resources on behalf of a resource owner, and lets end users authorize third-party access without sharing their passwords. It is informational, and was later superseded by OAuth 2.0 in RFC 6749.

eli5.summary: You give a valet a special key that only starts the car, instead of handing over your whole key ring. It was later replaced by a newer version.
